courier-relay-delivery-protocol-current: Purpose: preserve the approved Courier Relay delivery-receipt protocol contract for future work. Applicability: all count and summary requests in this project. Source: issue trial-4sf, provider adoption and integration-owner approval recorded 2026-09-07. Protocol 2 is current and is selected when protocol is omitted or explicitly "2"; protocol 1 remains supported when explicitly "1". Protocol 2 identity is the pair (account_id, delivery_id), selects the latest occurred_at UTC instant, breaks equal instants by smallest record_id using Unicode code-point order, counts all other receipts for that identity as duplicates, and keeps accepted receipts in original input order with original fields and timestamp spelling. Protocol 1 identity is delivery_id alone, selects the earliest UTC instant, and uses the same record_id tie-break. Timestamp comparison must normalize RFC3339 Z or numeric offsets to UTC, including date-boundary crossings. Requests are independent and the response reports the actual protocol.
